title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
title_zh: Wan-Streamer v0.1：端到端实时交互式基础模型
abstract_en: We present Wan-Streamer, a native-streaming, end-to-end interactive foundation model designed from the ground up for real-time, low-latency, full-duplex audio-visual interaction. Wan-Streamer seamlessly models language, audio, and video as both input and output within a single Transformer, where the sequence is represented as interleaved visual, audio, and text input tokens together with visual, audio, and text output tokens, coordinated by block-causal attention for incremental streaming. Unlike cascaded interactive systems that rely on separate VAD, ASR, language, TTS, audio-driven animation, or video-generation modules, Wan-Streamer does not rely on external language, speech, avatar, or video-generation modules: perception, reasoning, generation, response timing, turn management, and cross-modal synchronization are learned jointly within one unified model, reducing pipeline latency and error accumulation. To support natural audio-visual responsiveness, we redesign the entire stack around streamability, including causal encoders, causal decoders, block-causal attention, and low-latency multimodal token scheduling, enabling streaming units as short as 160 ms at 25 fps. Wan-Streamer achieves approximately 200 ms model-side response latency and approximately 550 ms total interaction latency when combined with 350 ms bidirectional network latency, supporting sub-second duplex audio-visual communication. These results position Wan-Streamer as a unified, end-to-end, multimodal interactive foundation model for low-latency streaming interaction.
abstract_zh: Wan-Streamer 是一个原生流式（native-streaming）的端到端交互式基础模型，面向实时、低延迟、全双工的音视频交互。它在单一 Transformer 中统一建模语言、音频和视频的输入与输出，将视觉、音频、文本输入 token 与对应输出 token 交错组织，并通过 block-causal attention 支持增量流式处理。不同于依赖 VAD、ASR、语言模型、TTS、音频驱动动画或视频生成等独立模块的级联系统，Wan-Streamer 将感知、推理、生成、响应时机、轮次管理和跨模态同步联合学习，从而降低流水线延迟和误差累积。为实现自然的音视频响应，论文围绕可流式性重新设计了因果编码器、因果解码器、block-causal attention 和低延迟多模态 token 调度，使流式单元可短至 160 ms、视频帧率达 25 fps。实验显示，Wan-Streamer 可实现约 200 ms 的模型侧响应延迟；在双向网络延迟约 350 ms 时，总交互延迟约 550 ms，支持亚秒级双工音视频通信。
key_points_zh: 提出 Wan-Streamer：一个原生流式、端到端、多模态交互基础模型，统一处理语言、音频和视频的输入与输出。
采用单一 Transformer 与交错多模态 token 表示，并通过 block-causal attention 实现增量流式推理与生成。
相比传统级联系统，Wan-Streamer 不依赖外部 VAD、ASR、TTS、avatar 或 video-generation 模块，减少系统延迟和误差传播。
围绕低延迟流式交互重构模型栈，包括 causal encoders、causal decoders、低延迟 token scheduling 等，支持 160 ms 流式单元和 25 fps 视频。
实现约 200 ms 模型侧响应延迟；结合 350 ms 双向网络延迟时，总交互延迟约 550 ms，适用于亚秒级全双工音视频通信。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong unified streaming multimodal agent that directly tackles low-latency full-duplex interaction with an end-to-end design.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一个很强的统一流式多模态智能体工作，直接以端到端方式解决低延迟全双工交互。
